comment: Overrides for swiftpm-notices.py when packaging/build-deb.sh writes /usr/share/doc/monkeyspaw/Third-Party-Notices.txt for the deb and Flatpak, whose binary is built with --static-swift-stdlib. Paths are relative to this file; $SWIFT_LICENSE is the toolchain's share/swift/LICENSE.txt, located by the build. The macOS app uses scripts/third-party-notices.json, the server image server/licenses/third-party-notices.json.
preamble: Monkey's Paw's own code is released under the Unlicense (see LICENSE in
https://github.com/L-K-M/MonkeysPaw). The components below are statically
linked into this program and keep their own licenses.

yams.reason: Yams vendors libyaml's C sources (Sources/CYaml, libyaml commit acd6f6f per Yams' 4.0.5 changelog) without libyaml's license file; this is libyaml's License at that commit.

components.name: ICU
components.reason: --static-swift-stdlib links Foundation's lib_FoundationICU (ICU 76.1 in swift-foundation-icu for Swift 6.4, data icudt76l). That repository ships only its Apache-2.0 LICENSE.md, while its ICU sources point to Unicode's terms, so this is unicode-org/icu's LICENSE at release-76-1 (SHA-256 01edac20612b1e590c1c1cfb02b7218c6adc7b0a944eda7a1e03aeee10725aed), including ICU's third-party data terms. static-runtime-notices.py fails when the binary's ICU data version differs.

components.name: Swift standard library, Foundation and libdispatch
components.reason: Statically linked by --static-swift-stdlib. The Runtime Library Exception waives attribution; listed for completeness with the toolchain's own LICENSE.txt.

components.name: Unicode Character Database tables
components.reason: Sources/MonkeysPawCore/Domain/Library/SearchUnicodeData.swift and Sources/MonkeysPawCore/Sync/SyncPathCaseFold.swift are generated from the UCD and compiled into Core.
